title: MEMORY.md frontmatter — memory/v1
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of a memory/v1 MEMORY.md file — the individual agent's own memory. This is a THIRD doctype: it neither absorbs nor replaces AIP-10 agentknowledge/v1 (curated, shareable wiki entries) nor AIP-11 learning/v1 (lessons). A memory/v1 document carries the AIP-10 base fields (schema, slug, kind, title, updated_at); the remaining fields codify the item shape Pygmalion already writes, and are OPTIONAL so an AIP-10-aligned writer and the current Pygmalion writer both round-trip through the same schema. The markdown body (the `body` property) is unrestricted text.

schema.description: Discriminator for a memory/v1 document. Optional only to tolerate legacy Pygmalion items written before this doctype existed; a canonical memory/v1 document MUST set it, and when present it MUST equal 'memory/v1'.

slug.description: Stable kebab-case identifier (AIP-10 convention). Used as the item's path stem and cross-reference target.

kind.description: Item kind (AIP-10 convention). Common values mirror Pygmalion's memory types: 'user', 'feedback', 'project', 'reference'.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last write (AIP-10 convention). MUST be set on every write.

id.description: Pygmalion item identifier (e.g. 'mem_qc8f407g'). Legacy alias for the AIP-10 path stem; when the base fields are omitted it takes part in identifying the item.

name.description: Pygmalion slugified name, distinct from `title`. Kept as a separate field so a Pygmalion write round-trips without loss.

type.description: Pygmalion memory type. The closed type set from the memory contract; `kind` is the AIP-10-aligned spelling of the same notion.

description.description: Pygmalion one-line human-readable summary, independent of the body.

tags.description: Free-form labels. Pygmalion writes formatted anchor labels here (e.g. 'global', 'project:fhcm', 'pr:agentproto/ts#1858').

polarity.description: Pygmalion feedback polarity. Present only on items of type 'feedback'.

lifetime.description: How long the item stays valid. Pygmalion writes { kind: 'durable' } or { kind: 'while', anchor: { … } }.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Pygmalion currently writes 'active'; the other values come from the memory-proposal contract.

written.description: Pygmalion last-write timestamp. Mirrors the AIP-10 `updated_at`.

rule.description: Classifier rule that produced the item (e.g. 'lens-confident', 'brain-memory-file').

source.description: Where the deciding rule came from (e.g. 'builtin').

decidedBy.description: Which classifier/rule decided the item's shape and status.

evidence.description: Trust/impact accounting captured at write time.

source.description: Capture source label (e.g. a transcript or memory-file source).

hash.description: Content hash of the captured/normalized body, used for dedup and evidence.

mode.description: Capture mode label (e.g. 'batch' — Pygmalion writer default).

producer.description: Producing component label (Pygmalion writer default 'unknown' when unset upstream).

capturedAt.description: ISO 8601 capture timestamp (mirrors `ts`; Pygmalion writer derives it from provenance.at when absent).

capture.description: Capture source/ts/hash trio for the item's source material.

anchors.description: Structured anchors scoping the item. Per-agent anchoring uses kind 'agent' with slug '<agent-slug>' (the 'agent:<slug>' form); other kinds are 'project', 'task', 'session', 'pr', 'contact', and the unscoped 'global'.

body.description: Unrestricted markdown body of the MEMORY.md file. Not constrained by this schema.

kind.description: Anchor kind. 'agent' extends the conversation-contract set for per-agent anchoring.

number.description: Pull-request number for a pr anchor.

anchor.description: A scope anchor. Loose-but-typed: enough keys to carry the conversation contract's forms — { kind: 'project'|'contact'|'agent', slug }, { kind: 'task'|'session', id }, { kind: 'pr', repo, number }, { kind: 'global' } — while accepting the uniform { kind, slug } shape for the slug-bearing kinds.

kind.description: Lifetime kind. 'durable' never expires; 'until' expires at `at`; 'while' lasts as long as `anchor` holds; 'session' lasts for the session.

sessionId.description: Session the claim was observed in.

ref.description: Opaque reference into the source (message uuid, file path, …).

origin.description: Origin-style provenance label, matching the runtime's SessionDescriptor.origin (e.g. 'cron:<id>', 'gate', 'chat-starter', 'vscode').

extractorVersion.description: Version of the extractor/classifier that derived the item (Pygmalion writer emits it in provenance).

provenance.description: Provenance record for a claim (Pygmalion names, plus the runtime origin label).

sourceKind.description: Kind of source the evidence came from (e.g. 'brain-transcript', 'brain-memory-file').

explicitness.description: Whether the claim was stated outright or inferred (e.g. 'implicit', 'explicit').

contradictsActive.description: True when this item contradicts an active item.

lifetime.description: Lifetime as computed for the evidence pass.

anchorsResolved.description: Resolved anchor labels in Pygmalion's formatted form (e.g. 'global', 'project:fhcm', 'pr:agentproto/ts#1858', 'session:sess_…').

ageHours.description: Age of the evidence in hours (may be fractional or negative relative to the write clock).

flags.description: Machine-stable flags raised during the evidence pass.

evidence.description: Evidence/trust accounting captured when the item was written.
